title: Oceans and seas
examples: What is the biggest ocean in the world?
Are all the oceans the same?
Which ocean is near the North Pole?

explain.say: Today we are learning about Earth's great oceans and seas.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of all the oceans.
The Atlantic Ocean is located between the Americas and Europe.
The Indian Ocean is bordered by Asia and Africa on two sides.
The Southern Ocean surrounds Antarctica, making it unique.
The Arctic Ocean is the smallest and is found near the North Pole.

faq.a: The Pacific Ocean contains the deepest point known to man. This deep spot is called the Mariana Trench.
asks: Where is the deepest part of the ocean?
What is the deepest ocean basin?

faq.q: Are all the oceans the same size?
faq.a: No, they are very different in size and depth. The Pacific is much larger than the Arctic.
asks: Do all oceans have the same dimensions?

faq.q: What is the difference between an ocean and a sea?
faq.a: Oceans are very large bodies of saltwater covering most of the Earth. Seas are often smaller parts of an ocean, sometimes partially enclosed by land.
asks: Is a sea smaller than an ocean?
Can a sea be part of an ocean?

faq.q: Where is the Southern Ocean located?
faq.a: The Southern Ocean circles the continent of Antarctica. It is a distinct body of water around the Antarctic landmass.
asks: Does the Southern Ocean go around Antarctica?

faq.q: Does the Arctic Ocean freeze completely?
faq.a: The Arctic Ocean does freeze over, especially in winter. However, it still has open water parts throughout the year.
asks: Is the Arctic Ocean always frozen?
What is the state of the Arctic Ocean?

facts: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean.
The Arctic Ocean is the smallest of the world's five oceans.
The Southern Ocean surrounds the continent of Antarctica.
The Atlantic Ocean separates the continents of the Americas and Eurasia.

quiz.say: Which ocean is known for being the largest and deepest?
quiz.why: The Pacific Ocean is correctly identified as the largest and deepest ocean basin.

wrong.0: The Atlantic is large, but it is not the largest or deepest.
wrong.1: The Indian Ocean is significant, but it is smaller than the Pacific.
wrong.2: The Arctic is the smallest, not the largest.

quiz.say: If you travel from North America to Europe, which ocean do you cross?
quiz.why: The Atlantic Ocean lies directly between the continents of North America and Europe.

wrong.1: The Pacific is much further west, near Asia and Australia.
wrong.2: The Indian Ocean is located between Africa and Asia.
wrong.3: The Southern Ocean is around Antarctica, not between those two continents.

quiz.say: What body of water surrounds the continent of Antarctica?
quiz.why: The Southern Ocean is specifically named for its location encircling Antarctica.

wrong.0: The Pacific is too far away in the western part of the globe.
wrong.1: The Atlantic is located between the Americas and Europe.
wrong.3: The Arctic is near the North Pole, not around Antarctica.
